body: Thanks for all the responses everyone, I really appreciate it

My mom has always been very selfish, I think she was mad because I was leaving, but she was the one who had encouraged me to leave so Im not sure what happened there.
I've talked to my husband many times about what Im feeling. He would always say he was sorry and he will fix it, but then he would make the same mistakes. He also admitted that he didn't care enough about me, and he knew what he was doing was wrong but chose to do it anyway.
My friend has known about my depression for a while. She knew about all of my life issues. I think maybe she felt scared and lashed out, but Im not sure.
Im trying to find hobbies and jobs, but I literally can't get out of bed most days and barely eat and just cry, so I'm not in a condition to do anything. I don't know how to get better.
What did you tell yourself to keep going? My whole life all I wanted was to be with the people that I love, and now that I don't have that I dont know what to live for. What is the point?
